Sasha: Hey all — want to run a quick dry-run + design review for the consolidated API/SDK/Console changes (RFC #412). Goal: verify API surface, SDK ergonomics, console flows, and rollout signals. Prefer 1hr slot with 20m demo + 25m feedback + 15m follow-ups. Pre-read: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/412 (PR + proto screenshots)

Sasha: Proposed slots: Tue 3/22 10:00-11:00 PST, Wed 3/23 16:00-17:00 PST, Thu 3/24 09:00-10:00 PST. Please react with :thumbsup: for preferred slot or reply with exact conflicts.

Oliver: Tue works for me (1). I'll present SDK changes if Maya can cover console flows.

Maya: I can do Tue or Wed. I'll take console UX + screenshot walk.

Liam: Wed preferred for infra reasons (deploy window). If Tue wins I can sync with ops before.

Sasha: Presenters: Oliver (SDK), Maya (Console), Sasha (API surface + rollout). Also need someone to own pre-read checklist & notes.

Sara: I'll take notes and capture action items.

dev-bot: @Oliver Canary env "canary-412" is available on 213.45.12.8:9000, creds in 1password/dev/canary-412
